notes.title: Coming (really) soon!
notes.notes:
[h3][h1]Finally, the first build for the Steam version of the game has been updated to Steam.[/h1][/h3]

I am personally testing it right now! It will be released after it has been thoroughly tested and all bugs found are fixed.

Won't be long now... Stay tuned!

notes.title: The Lonely Hacker will have a PC port on Steam!
notes.notes:
[b]I am happy to announce that The Lonely hacker will soon have a PC port!
[/b]
In the meantime, you can play the game on your mobile phone! Get it from the Google Play Store or the Apple App Store!

More news coming soon!
